Most tools start and stop with dashboards. We start with the hard part: turning fragmented, messy enterprise data into a consistent foundation people can trust. Then we use AI to make it conversational, so anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer they can act on.

  • Systems others build on: The pipelines and tools you've built are reliable, documented and used by the team without needing you.

Why is this role important for Pennylane?

Pennylane is creating Pennylane Financial Services (PFS), a subsidiary seeking ACPR authorisation as a payment institution and financing company, to serve its 1.6 million SMB customers base.

  1. This is a 0-to-1 role: you will lay the foundations of PFS’s accounting model, controls and reporting as the business is built.

  2. You ensure the reliability of PFS’s financial information, from product events and accounting entries through to financial and prudential reporting.

  3. You check daily that client funds are safeguarded and that PFS meets its own funds requirements and applicable prudential ratios. You flag risks early and help the Head of Finance anticipate capital needs.

You report to Maxime Leclercq, GM PFS, and functionally to @Raphaël Nahum, Head of Finance, on accounting standards and methods aligned with group finance.

How will you contribute to the project?

You build from scratch the accounting model and controls with Product and Tech, then run daily accounting until volumes justify a dedicated operator.

You own the figures and accounting decisions, and prepare the accounting-based prudential reports. You collaborate with our Regulatory Lead, who oversees reporting deadlines, completeness and reviews, the reports before submission.

You would be a great fit if:

  • You can work with incomplete information and make decisions, assumptions and open questions clear.

  • You document accounting decisions and are able to defend them internally and externally, including to statutory auditors and the ACPR.

What will your day-to-day responsibilities be?

Build

  • Design and test payment and financing accounting schemes in the Core Banking System, the accounting interpreter, working closely with Product and Tech teams

  • Document the accounting impact of each product before launch.

  • Reconcile the ledger, general ledger, bank accounts and reports. Keep each reported figure traceable to its transactions.

  • Set up RUBA and COREP reporting, including dry runs, with the Regulatory Lead.

Operational accounting

  • Reconcile payment accounts (eg. SCT, SDD, cards, cheques) against the settlement account daily. Check safeguarding coverage, keep evidence and flag shortfalls.

  • Check own funds requirements, applicable ratios and available buffers daily.

  • Forecast the amount and timing of capital needs with the Head of Finance and FP&A

  • Resolve and document exceptions.

  • Account for doubtful receivables, provisions, write-offs and reversals.

  • Prepare closing entries, reconcile intercompany balances with Pennylane SAS and support statutory closings.

Strategic contributions

  • Prepare the accounting, exposure and provisioning materials for the committee that sets credit risk appetite, overall exposure and counterparty limits.

  • Quantify the accounting, provisioning and capital impact of new products, pricing or volume scenarios before launch.

  • Alert the Head of Finance early on capital needs, prudential constraints and standards changes (PCEC, ACPR) that affect the model.

  • Work closely with Pennylane’s Accounting Manager and the FP&A team to align on definitions, key metrics, and group procedures

Profile we are looking for

Must-have:

  • At least 6–7 years of experience, ideally in financial services audit followed by accounting in a payment institution, financing company or bank.

  • Strong PCEC, doubtful receivables and provisioning knowledge.

  • Able to both build the accounting model and run daily reconciliations, exceptions and closings.

  • Comfortable working with incomplete information and owning accounting decisions.

  • Able to query large datasets independently.

  • Works well with Engineering, Product, Data, Operations and the Regulatory Lead, with clear responsibilities.

  • Professional French and English: documentation and regulatory exchanges are in French; teams work in English.

Nice-to-have:

  • DEC or equivalent.

  • SQL.

  • Core banking or accounting interpreter experience.

  • Experience building accounting and controls for a new entity or licensing programme.

  • ACPR reporting experience (RUBA, COREP).

The Embedded AI team owns the first layer. We build the specialized machine learning systems behind Copilot and Autopilot: invoice parsing, document classification, accounting suggestions, matching, scoring, Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.

Models are commoditizing fast. What makes the difference is our ability to frame the right problem, use Pennylane’s data and accounting knowledge, evaluate quality on real workflows, and operate reliable systems in production.

By joining us as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI, you will turn difficult accounting problems into trusted ML products used every day. You will combine strong ML engineering, product thinking and production ownership to improve both automation and user trust.

HOW you will contribute as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI

You will join the Embedded AI team within our ML & AI organization. The team works closely with product squads and accounting experts, from initial exploration to production, monitoring and continuous improvement.

  • You will design and ship ML systems for document understanding, extraction, classification, matching, ranking, scoring and recommendations.

  • You will contribute directly to our Copilot and Autopilot experiences, including Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.

  • You will own the full lifecycle of your solutions: problem framing, data and labeling strategy, baselines, training, evaluation, deployment, experimentation, monitoring and maintenance.

  • You will turn user corrections and production failures into better datasets, models and product behavior.

  • You will define quality metrics that reflect real user value: precision and recall, automation coverage, straight-through processing, human correction rate, latency and cost.

  • You will partner with Product, Engineering and accounting experts to understand workflows, define what “correct” means and integrate ML naturally into the user experience.

  • You will choose the simplest reliable approach for each problem — deterministic logic, classical ML, deep learning or generative AI — rather than starting from a preferred model.

  • You will help improve our shared ML engineering practices: reusable components, experimentation, observability, data quality and reliable training and inference pipelines.

  • You will stay ahead of the curve by monitoring emerging ML and AI techniques — including multimodal and generative models — and applying them when they create measurable value.

WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane

Within one month:

  • You will learn about Pennylane, our users, our accounting workflows and our AI vision during onboarding.

  • You will get familiar with our ML stack, production systems, datasets, metrics and ways of working.

  • You will meet your product and engineering partners and contribute to a first scoped improvement.

Within 3 months:

  • You will own an Embedded AI use case end to end, with clear offline and production metrics.

  • You will have shipped a meaningful improvement to a Copilot or Autopilot capability.

  • You will be comfortable with our technical stack, including Python, Pytorch, PySpark, Redshift, Airflow, AWS SageMaker and our monitoring tools.

  • You will use real user feedback and error analysis to prioritize the next iterations.

Within 6 months:

  • You will lead larger cross-team ML projects and help shape the Embedded AI roadmap.

  • You will improve the reliability, automation coverage and maintainability of one or more production systems.

  • You will share best practices and raise the bar for ML engineering, evaluation and production ownership across the team.

And beyond: the ML & AI teams will continue growing with the company

This means opportunities to mentor new team members, lead major product initiatives and help define the technical standards that make trusted AI possible at Pennylane.

  • Have 5–8 years of experience and are very strong in Python.

  • Have hands-on experience building and operating machine learning systems at scale in production — not only training models or running notebooks.

  • Know how to frame an ambiguous product problem, establish a baseline and select useful metrics before optimizing a model.

  • Have strong experience in several of these areas: document AI, NLP, classification, ranking, recommendation, anomaly detection, deep learning or generative AI.

  • Care about data quality, observability, failure modes, cost and long-term maintainability as much as model performance.

  • Have a balanced blend of technical, business and product skills, and communicate well with software engineers, product managers and non-technical domain experts.

  • Are fluent in English; French is not mandatory.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with accounting, fintech or other high-trust business workflows.

  • Experience with human-in-the-loop systems, active learning or learning from user corrections.

  • Experience running ML systems at scale with strict latency, reliability or cost constraints.

  • Familiarity with multimodal or generative models for document understanding.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

- Tu intègres Pennylane et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

Compétences requises

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul.e et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière.

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique comptable, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et tu cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et de cabinets à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

Compétences requises

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul(e) et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

    quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

    We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.

    We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

    Why this role exists

    Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.

    The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents.     This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

    What you will own

    • Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

    • The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

    • The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.

    • Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.

    • The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.

    • The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.

    Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built.

    How we work

    We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here.

    We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way.

    And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production.     Your first year

    In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival.

    • You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies.

    • You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises.

    • You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over.

    • English is your working language. German is a plus.

    What makes you stand out

    • You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax.

    • You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model.

    • You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama.

    • You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it.

    The team

    We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action.

You'll take part in the whole development lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through pull requests to release. Your product judgement, and your ability to bring people with competing priorities to a clear decision, matter here as much as your cartographic craft.

Take part in planning, refinement and reviews, provide design specifications engineers can act on, and review visual output during development and before release.

Reach a decision with the people who own the product, record it and see it through. 

    • Contribute to Renderer and Tooling Requirements Provide detailed input on the data and rendering capabilities needed to achieve design goals. Define requirements for internal cartographic authoring tools and identify workflow improvements that raise the team's output quality and speed.

    • Sound judgement under constraint. You can point to decisions where you gave something up to ship, and explain why it was right for the product and its users.

    • Comfort with disagreement. You challenge a decision with evidence, accept the outcome when it goes the other way and keep the work moving.

    Deepdesk, part of AnywhereNow, powers AI Assistants and Virtual Agents for enterprise contact centres, helping brands such as Achmea, Vodafone and DHL boost productivity today while scaling for the future of customer experience.     Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

    About the role:

    We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to build and run the agents at the heart of Tebi OS. You’ll design, ship, evaluate and scale our Product Agents, along with the data pipelines, tools and infrastructure that make them reliable in production.

    The ideal candidate started in data or ML engineering and has since moved into AI engineering, building LLM-powered agents for real users.     • Build the data foundations agents rely on, including real-time and batch pipelines over financial and operational data, retrieval layers, and well-modeled datasets agents can query safely and accurately

    • Turn APIs and internal services into well-defined agent tools, and own the contracts between agents and the rest of the platform

    • Set up evaluation for agent behavior: offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge and human review, regression testing on prompt and model changes, and feedback loops that improve agents over time

    • Own observability for agents in production by tracing sessions, tool calls and model calls, and tracking latency, cost, error rates and quality

    • Work with product teams to find where agents can meaningfully improve the customer experience or internal workflows, and say clearly where they can’t

    • Make sure agents handle data securely and responsibly, with sensible guardrails, access controls, and protection against prompt injection and data leakage

    What you’ll bring:

    • 7+ years in software engineering, with a solid base in data or ML engineering

    • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM agents to production, not just prototypes. You’ve dealt with flaky tool calls, runaway loops, hallucinated arguments and token budgets, and you have opinions on how to handle them.

    • Strong data modeling and data warehousing fundamentals, plus experience with ingestion, transformation and data quality

    • Strong SQL, and experience with pipeline tools (e.g. Airflow, dbt) and analytical or cloud data platforms (e.g. ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake)

    • Experience evaluating and monitoring LLM systems, and an understanding of the full lifecycle from experiment to deployment to ongoing improvement

    • Backend engineering skills: you’re comfortable building the API endpoint that exposes an agent’s output to the frontend, or the service an agent calls as a tool

    • Clear communication, including the ability to explain trade-offs in latency, cost, accuracy and complexity to product partners

    • A product mindset. You care about how your work lands with users, and you’re keen to meet customers face to face to understand their needs.

    This probably isn't the role for you if you have been working with AI agents to improve your day to day working flows but you haven’t built an Agent in the production.

    • Competitive Salary

    • Lunch Provided in Office

    • Team building events

    • Unlimited time off

    What is Restaurant Software?

    Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

    From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

    How we use AI at Tebi

    We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

    At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

    Wil jij bouwen aan de woningbouwopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige vastgoedprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na tendergunning en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met bouwpartners én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid.

     

    Dit wordt jouw baan

    Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke vastgoedprojecten en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de bouw om projecten succesvol richting uitvoering te brengen. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om in de toekomst ontwikkelaars te begeleiden en bijvoorbeeld door te groeien naar een rol als Hoofd Vastgoedontwikkeling.

     

    Wat ga je doen

    Deze functie richt zich nadrukkelijk niet op de initiatieffase of acquisitiekant van gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen en projecten daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd gaan worden. Je werkt aan (midel)grote woningbouwontwikkelingen van honderden woningen en bent de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het realiseren van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie.

    ·       Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning tot aan de start van de realisatie;

    ·       Je stuurt het ontwikkelproces aan op het gebied van kwaliteit, planning, financiën en risico's;

    ·       Je verbindt de belangen van gemeenten, adviseurs, beleggers, corporaties, bouwteams en andere stakeholders;

    ·       Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van Bouw om projecten optimaal uitvoerbaar en haalbaar te maken;

    ·       Je vertaalt ambities en plannen naar concrete ontwikkelbeslissingen die bijdragen aan een succesvolle uitvoering;

    ·       Je voert regie op vergunningstrajecten, overeenkomsten en besluitvorming;

    ·       Je bewaakt de businesscase en stuurt op waardecreatie gedurende het gehele ontwikkelproces;

    ·       Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere opbouw en professionalisering van de ontwikkelorganisatie;

    ·       Je begeleidt en coacht minder ervaren projectontwikkelaars en krijgt de ruimte om op termijn een meer aansturende rol te vervullen.

    Meer bij Dura Vermeer

    Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

    Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

    Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.


    Hier zit je op jouw plek

    Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling.

    Dat betekent dat je terechtkomt in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. Met ruim 100 collega's binnen onze werkmaatschappij bouwen we niet alleen aan duurzame woningen, utiliteitsprojecten en leefomgevingen, maar ook aan de toekomst van onze eigen organisatie. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen.

    Hier krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar midden in een frisse organisatie die zich verder ontwikkelt en waarin ondernemerschap, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Samen bouwen we aan projecten waar we trots op zijn én aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst.


    Dit breng jij mee

    Shift Supervisor | DSL-01

    Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. Iemand die meedenkt over procedures, voorbereiding van de commissioning en startup en helpt om operators klaar te stomen voor het moment waarop de installatie daadwerkelijk gaat draaien. DSL-01 wordt een grootschalige productiefaciliteit voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) en bijproducten.

     

    Over de functie

    Als Shift Supervisor speel je een sleutelrol in de veilige, stabiele en efficiënte operatie van DSL-01. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie.

    Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES.

    Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken.

    Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

    Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar):

    • Werk je in dagdienst

    • Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01

    • Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies

    • Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators

    • Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie

    • Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek.

    In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028):

    • Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators in een 5-ploegendienst binnen een volcontinu productieproces.

    • Bewaak je de veilige en efficiënte productie van SAF, propaan, butaan en nafta.

    • Monitor je procesprestaties via DCS- en MES-systemen, stuur je bij waar nodig en zorg je ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits- en rendementsdoelstellingen worden gerealiseerd.

    Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het naleven van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsstandaarden, neem je de leiding bij incidenten en calamiteiten en coördineer je werkzaamheden tussen Operations, Maintenance en andere betrokken disciplines. Ook speel je een actieve rol in het continu verbeteren van processen en het verder versterken van de veiligheidscultuur binnen de fabriek.

    Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het ontwikkelen van het operationele team. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei van operators, zowel op technisch vlak als in competenties zoals samenwerking, eigenaarschap en veiligheidsbewustzijn. Door coaching, begeleiding en duidelijke verwachtingen zorg je voor een sterk team dat veilig, effectief en met vertrouwen kan opereren.

     

    Jouw profiel

    SkyNRG is een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie.

    Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en voelt je op je plek in een omgeving die continu in beweging is.

    Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

    • Ervaring en affiniteit met Procestechniek, Chemische Technologie of een vergelijkbare richting

    • Minimaal een afgeronde VAPRO C of AOT niveau 4-opleiding

    • Minimaal 10 jaar ervaring binnen de chemische, petrochemische, raffinage- of vergelijkbare procesindustrie

    • Aantoonbare operationele leidinggevende ervaring en bewezen people development skills

    • Ervaring met procesautomatisering en het werken met DCS- en MES-systemen

    • Kennis van procesveiligheid, werkvergunningensystemen en relevante wet- en regelgeving

    • Ervaring met het nemen van operationele beslissingen in situaties waar veiligheid, kwaliteit en continuïteit samenkomen

    Welkome extra kennis en ervaring:

    • Ervaring binnen greenfield-projecten of grootschalige industriële bouw- en opstartprojecten

    • Ervaring met commissioning, startup en operational readiness

    • Kennis van raffinage-, hydroprocessing- of duurzame brandstofprocessen

    • Ervaring met continue verbeterprogramma's en performance management

    Over DSL-01

    In Delfzijl bouwen wij aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.

    DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten.

    De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

    We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal.

    Waarom deze rol?

    Deze functie biedt een kans die maar weinig operators en shift supervisors krijgen. Je bent vanaf een vroeg stadium betrokken bij de realisatie van een compleet nieuwe fabriek en kunt jouw operationele expertise inzetten om invloed uit te oefenen op commissioning, procedures, opleidingen en de uiteindelijke manier van werken.

    Na de opstart maak je de stap naar een operationele omgeving waarin je leiding geeft aan een moderne productie-installatie en een belangrijke rol speelt in het neerzetten van de standaarden, cultuur en prestaties van de fabriek.

    Tegelijkertijd draag je direct bij aan de realisatie van een van Europa's eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken. Een unieke kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuwe productieorganisatie én een tastbare bijdrage te leveren aan de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

    NB: Voor de opbouw van de operationele organisatie zoeken we uiteindelijk vijf Shift Supervisors. De eerste twee Supervisors starten tijdens de project- en opstartfase van DSL-01. Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process)

Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare:

Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n.

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • Convex for data + backend logic

  • n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation

  • TypeScript

Requirements

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

  • Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.”

  • Show:

  • A read-only list of available tools (name and category only, no owner details), pulled from Convex.

  • A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk.

Authenticated experience

  • Only signed-in users can:

  • List a tool with:

  • name

  • category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.)

  • condition

  • short description

  • Request to borrow a tool for a date range.

  • Approve or decline requests on their own tools.

  • Mark a loan as returned.

  • Show:

Roles & rules

  • Have two roles:

  • user:

    • Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing.

  • Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.

Automation with n8n

  • Build at least two n8n workflows:

  • Request notification: when a borrow request is created or changes status, Convex calls an n8n Webhook. The workflow notifies the relevant user (email, Slack, Discord, or a logged mock notification is fine) using only the fields it needs.

  • Handle failures with retries and an error workflow (or equivalent) so failed runs are visible and never fail silently.

  • A GitHub repository with the app source code.

  • Exported n8n workflow JSON files in the repository.

  • A README covering local setup (including n8n, e.g. a docker-compose file), environment variables, architecture, and your security and data-minimization decisions.

  • A short note on what you would change to run this in production.

  • Code structure and clarity

  • Security-minded thinking

  • UX and practicality

  • Integration design, reliability, and error handling (n8n)

  • Documentation and reasoning

  • In-depth understanding of solid wood, veneers, engineered boards (MDF and plywood), laminates, hardware fittings, and finishing methods.
  • Proven experience leading, managing, and guiding technical and production teams.

    • TopSolid
  • Experience with parametric modeling and automation tools, such as Grasshopper.

About CareAtlas Inc.

CareAtlas is a mission-driven healthcare services company that helps Medicare patients, especially older adults managing complex chronic conditions, live healthier, more independent lives.

We work as an extension of provider teams, delivering Remote Patient Monitoring and Chronic Care Management to patients across Texas and California. We combine consistent human relationships, timely monitoring, and clear clinical escalation to support rural and aging populations.

About the role

Location: Remote (United States)

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time, full time

Compensation: $15.00 to $36.00 per hour, depending on the type of work

Reports to: COO, Care Delivery

Patient panel: Up to 200 patients

Our Care Navigators are the people our patients come to know and trust. You will take in new patient referrals from the practices we partner with and enroll them into the program, then manage a panel of roughly 200 older Medicare patients — reviewing their submitted monitoring data during scheduled working hours and speaking with them regularly by name and with an understanding of their individual circumstances. This is not a high-volume call center role. Continuity matters. You will learn what is typical for each patient, recognize when something meets an established escalation criterion, and notice practical barriers that may be getting in the way of care.

You will not diagnose conditions, change medications, or make treatment decisions. You will follow defined protocols and escalate clinical questions to a Clinical Navigator who is an RN or to the provider team. You will have a defined clinical escalation pathway and ongoing support from the care team behind you, and, as one of our early employees, real room to improve the patient experience and the workflows that support it.

What you will do

  • Build trusted relationships through consistent and compassionate outbound patient communication.
  • Manage an assigned patient panel and complete scheduled outreach and follow-up.
  • Review remotely transmitted readings such as blood pressure, glucose, and weight.
  • Identify readings or changes that meet established escalation criteria or differ from patient-specific parameters.
  • Escalate concerns promptly with the readings, symptoms, history, and patient context that clinicians need.
  • Help patients set up and use monitoring devices with patience and confidence.
  • Reinforce clinician-approved care plans without providing medical advice independently.
  • Identify barriers related to transportation, cost, medication access, technology, or social support, and connect patients with approved resources.
  • Document interactions, outreach attempts, device support, and escalations accurately and promptly.
  • Follow CareAtlas privacy, security, documentation, and quality standards.
  • Participate in team huddles, training, and practical process improvement.
  • Receive & process new patient referrals from partner provider practices and complete timely outreach.
  • Confirm program eligibility, explain Remote Patient Monitoring and Chronic Care Management in plain language, and obtain and document patient consent to enroll.
  • Track each referral through to enrollment or a documented reason the patient did not enroll, and keep the referring practice informed.

Required qualifications

  • At least one year of patient-facing healthcare experience.
  • Experience communicating with older adults or people managing chronic conditions.
  • Exceptional patience, warmth, and clarity, especially with people who may be frightened, tired, frustrated, hard of hearing, or unfamiliar with technology.
  • Sound judgment about when to follow a workflow and when to ask for help.
  • Strong written documentation and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities reliably in a remote work environment.
  • Comfort learning EHRs, remote monitoring platforms, and other web-based tools.
  • Ability to perform the essential responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Preferred qualifications

  • CMA, CNA, EMT, Paramedic, community health worker, medical assistant, or another relevant credential
  • Experience with RPM, CCM, geriatrics, primary care, home health, or care coordination
  • Professional fluency in Spanish
  • Experience enrolling or onboarding patients into a care program

What success looks like

  • Patients feel known, respected, and supported.
  • Monitoring reviews and scheduled outreach are completed reliably.
  • Escalations are timely, accurate, and include the context clinicians need.
  • Documentation is complete and submitted on time.
  • Device and care plan barriers are identified and followed through appropriately.
  • Workload, safety, and patient concerns are communicated early.
  • New referrals are contacted quickly, enrolled or closed out with a clear reason, and referring practices are kept informed.

Compensation and benefits

This is an hourly, non-exempt position eligible for overtime under federal and state law. Patient-facing work is paid at $36.00 per hour. Administrative work is paid at $15.00 per hour, or the applicable federal, state, or local minimum wage where you work, whichever is higher. The range reflects the two kinds of work in the role rather than a seniority band.

  • 10 days of paid time off per year, accrued, plus seven paid company holidays.
  • Paid sick leave, accrued separately from paid time off.
  • Two weeks of paid parental leave at full pay.
  • A company provided laptop and headset, and reimbursement of work related internet and phone costs where state law requires it.

CareAtlas does not currently offer health, dental, vision, or retirement benefits. We would rather say that up front than imply otherwise, and this will be updated as the company grows.

Equal opportunity and accommodations

CareAtlas is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to any status protected by applicable law. Applicants who need reasonable accommodation during the hiring process may contact .

How to apply

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled, and will be accepted at minimum through October 15, 2026.

Position: Ad Operations Learning Specialist

Work setup: Work from home

Why join MicroSourcing?

You'll have:

  • Competitive Rewards: Enjoy above-market compensation, healthcare coverage on day one, plus one or more dependents, paid time-off with cash conversion, group life insurance, and performance bonuses

  • A Collaborative Spirit: Contribute to a positive and engaging work environment by participating in company-sponsored events and activities.

  • Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy the balance between work and life that suits you with flexible work arrangements.

  • Career Growth: Take advantage of opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.

  • Inclusive Teamwork: Be part of a team that celebrates diversity and fosters an inclusive culture.

Key Responsibilities

The Ad Operations Learning Specialist is an individual-contributor role responsible for preparing new and existing employees to perform accurate, efficient, and compliant digital advertising operations. The specialist delivers new-hire, refresher, remedial, and cross-training; assists with client-specific and platform-specific training; and partners with subject matter experts and team leads to translate operational processes into structured learning.

The role requires at least two years of hands-on Ad Operations experience and demonstrated experience implementing or delivering structured training, which may have been gained in another professional discipline. The specialist develops training materials, evaluates production readiness, supports employees during nesting and early production, conducts skill set reviews, and may coordinate with clients or external partners when required.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Training Delivery and Facilitation

  • Deliver new-hire, refresher, remedial, and cross-training for Ad Operations employees in classroom and virtual environments.

  • Assist with client-specific and platform-specific training in partnership with subject matter experts and team leads, including practical exercises and campaign simulations.

  • Adapt training pace and approach to learner needs while reinforcing accuracy, quality assurance, information security, and process compliance.

  • Curriculum and Documentation

  • Creating training materials, practical exercises, assessments, SOPs, job aids, or educational content.

  • Translate workflows, platform procedures, and client requirements into clear, accurate, and standardized training content.

  • Maintain version control and training records and incorporate approved process, platform, and policy changes into learning materials.

  • Assessment, Readiness, and Skill Set Reviews

  • Administer knowledge checks and practical evaluations, document results, and provide timely, actionable feedback to trainees and stakeholders.

  • Assess production readiness and recommend advancement to production, additional coaching, or remediation based on demonstrated knowledge, accuracy, and independent performance.

  • Conduct skill set reviews for existing employees, identify capability gaps, and support targeted development and cross-training plans.

  • Post-Training Support and Collaboration

  • Support nesting and early production through observation, coaching, and coordination with team leads, quality assurance personnel, and operational subject matter experts.

  • Track training outcomes and recurring performance or error trends and use findings to improve curriculum and targeted learning interventions.

  • Collaborate primarily with internal stakeholders and, when required, clients or external partners; communicate learner progress, risks, and training needs clearly and professionally.

Qualifications and Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in any field from an accredited institution is required.

  • A minimum of two years of hands-on Ad Operations experience is required, including experience with campaign setup or trafficking, quality assurance, monitoring, reporting, optimization, or related campaign-management activities.

  • Demonstrated experience implementing or delivering structured training, onboarding, coaching, or formal knowledge transfer is required; this experience may be in Ad Operations or another professional discipline.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of the following platforms, or a directly comparable advertising platform, is required: Google Ad Manager, Campaign Manager 360, Display & Video 360, FreeWheel, The Trade Desk, Google Ads, Search Ads 360, Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, or Operative.

  • Intermediate or higher proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, sorting, filtering, formatting, structured data, and spreadsheet-based reporting, with the capacity to learn more advanced functionality quickly.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.

  • Exceptional attention to detail, sound judgment, strong organization and time management, and the ability to assess performance, deliver constructive feedback, manage multiple training priorities, and adapt to changing operational requirements.

Preferred Experience and Knowledge:

  • Experience supporting nesting, production-readiness decisions, remedial coaching, skill matrices, or structured skill set reviews.

  • Experience across multiple digital advertising channels or platforms, as well as coordination with clients, external partners, or operational subject matter experts.

Our team of legal and clinical professionals brings more than 700 years of combined MSP industry experience, serving insurance carriers, self-insured companies, third-party administrators, and governmental entities across the country.

Recognized as one of the fastest-growing MSP compliance companies in the nation, Sanderson Firm was ranked #667 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing privately held companies, following our #92 ranking in 2025. This continued recognition reflects our significant growth and commitment to innovation within the MSP industry. We are proud of our 100% client retention rate and our reputation for delivering innovative solutions that help clients achieve MSP-compliant settlements.

At Sanderson Firm, you’ll join a fast-growing, collaborative team where your work makes a meaningful impact on our clients and the industry. We are committed to fostering a supportive environment where employees are valued, ideas are encouraged, and contributions directly help shape the future of our firm. Join us today and be part of what’s next at Sanderson Firm!

POSITION SUMMARY

The Medicare Set-Aside (MSA) Specialist is responsible for developing future medical allocation reports based on evidence-based medical guidelines and guidance published by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS). In this role, the specialist will apply clinical expertise and professional judgment to prepare Medical Cost Projections and Medicare Set-Asides for workers’ compensation and liability settlements in accordance with established standards of practice.

The ideal candidate has strong analytical skills, clinical knowledge, and experience interpreting medical records to support accurate and compliant MSA allocations. Experience with Evidence-Based Medicare Set-Asides (EBMSAs) is strongly preferred.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Reviews and analyzes medical records, billing and payment documentation, and pharmacy histories to identify an injured individual’s past, current, and future treatment needs related to an accident or injury.
  • Prepares clear and concise medical record summary narratives that outline findings and recommendations.
  • Applies evidence-based medical treatment guidelines, including CMS guidelines, when developing future care recommendations.
  • Documents and supports the rationale for findings and overall case analysis.
  • Identifies and differentiates between Medicare-covered and non-Medicare-covered treatments.
  • Assigns and incorporates appropriate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD codes based on case specifics.
  • Communicates and collaborates with claims professionals, attorneys, physicians and their representatives, clients, and internal team members.
  • Maintains company quality standards and adheres to documentation requirements.
  • Meets weekly productivity goals while ensuring accuracy and regulatory compliance.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word and Excel, for document preparation and data management.
  • Effectively multitasks in a high-volume environment while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the capability to present information clearly and professionally.

ClearPath Partners () is a buy-side deal origination firm. As a Senior SDR, you will generate new opportunities by cold calling business owners, introducing our mandate plainly, and qualifying fit before an introduction is made. The list, tools, script, training, and everything you need will be provided. You bring the conversations. This is not a turn-and-burn dialing role. Our target lists are tight and highly researched, which means most of the owners you reach are a strong potential fit. Your job is to call efficiently, listen closely, ask good questions, and capture the few data points that matter. We want someone who looks at who they are calling, not someone racing to hit a dial count.

About Concern

Established in 1968, Concern is a non-profit, non-governmental humanitarian organisation, dedicated to the reduction of suffering and the ultimate elimination of extreme poverty in the world’s poorest countries.

Concern’s vision, our mission and our work are all defined by one goal – ending extreme poverty, whatever it takes. Concern strives for a world free from poverty, fear and oppression.

Our culture is values driven and we believe that our people are central to all that we do and are key to delivering on our goal of Reaching the Furthest Behind First. We are committed to ensuring a workplace where everybody feels valued and are enabled to succeed in their work and contribute to delivering on our mission.

Overview and Purpose

Concern Worldwide is committed to addressing extreme poverty while ensuring that all programmes uphold the safety, dignity, and rights of affected populations. Accordingly, this role is an integral part of Concern’s Safe & Inclusive Programming Unit (SIPU) and will contribute to the Unit’s shared purpose of enabling high quality, risk informed programming.

The Global Technical Adviser - Humanitarian Protection will provide dedicated technical support on protection mainstreaming, protection analysis, with a particular emphasis on GBV response programming. This will include case management support and tool development, filling a critical gap in specialist coverage for countries delivering highly technical protection and GBV programmes. This role requires proficiency in French as it will include support to Concern’s programming in French-speaking countries.

Reports to: Director of Safe & Inclusive Programming

Department: Emergency Directorate

Terms: 2 years, fixed term

Location: Ireland (remote) with frequent travel to any of Concern’s countries of operation.

Salary: GB6 - €57,683 - €64,092

Requirements: Total travel time may be for up to a total of 120 days across the course of the year.

Responsibilities

1. Strategic Leadership and Technical Direction

  • Lead the development and implementation of Concern’s global approach to protection programming, particularly around GBV prevention and response.
  • Provide technical oversight and guidance to country teams on protection programming across humanitarian and development contexts, with emphasis on GBV prevention and response.
  • Work closely with Equality and Conflict Advisors to promote gender and conflict-transformative approaches that address root causes of GBV, including inequality and harmful social norms.

2. Programme Design and Quality Assurance

  • Support country teams in the design of programmes, including standalone and integrated approaches.
  • Ensure programmes are aligned with international standards and best practices, including survivor-centred approaches.
  • Review proposals, logframes, and reports to ensure strong integration of GBV risk mitigation and response.

3. Integration and Mainstreaming

  • Lead efforts to integrate GBV risk mitigation across sectors such as livelihoods, health and nutrition, WASH, and education.
  • Contribute to strengthening linkages and cohesion between GBV, protection mainstreaming, safeguarding, conflict sensitivity, and equality as core functions of SIPU, ensuring our protection and GBV programming aligns with CHS commitments.
  • Support the use of safe, inclusive, and conflict-sensitive programming approaches.

4. Capacity Building and Technical Support

  • Develop and deliver training and capacity strengthening initiatives for staff and partners on GBV prevention and response.
  • Provide ongoing remote and in-country technical support and mentoring.
  • Build the capacity of teams to safely identify, refer, and respond to GBV cases in line with ethical standards.

5. Accountability

  • Promote safe referral pathways and confidential, ethical data management practices.
  • Strengthen accountability to affected populations, particularly women and girls.

6. Knowledge Management and Learning

  • Lead the documentation of best practices, lessons learned, and innovations in GBV programming.
  • Contribute to organisational learning, research, and evidence-building initiatives.
  • Support the development of tools, guidance, and case studies.

7. Representation and External Engagement

  • Represent Concern in global GBV and protection coordination forums such as IC-GBV.
  • Engage with donors, partners, and inter-agency networks.
  • Contribute to advocacy initiatives on GBV and protection.

Role Holder Requirements

Essential

  • Degree in gender studies, social sciences, international development, or related field, together with strong understanding of global GBV standards and guidelines (e.g., Inter-Agency Minimum Standards for GBV).
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in GBV programming in humanitarian response work, preferably in conflict or insecure environments.
  • Demonstrated expertise in GBV prevention and response, including survivor-centred approaches.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and report-writing skills in French and English
  • Proven experience and impact in programme design, proposal development, and donor engagement.
  • Proven experience in providing technical advice and support to field programmes and implementing partners.
  • Proven experience in training, facilitation, and capacity building of staff and partners
  • Ability to work in complex and insecure environments.

Desirable

  • Experience working at regional or global level within an INGO.
  • Knowledge of safeguarding, protection mainstreaming, conflict sensitivity and gender equality programming.
  • Experience of working in fragile or conflict-affected contexts.

Applications for this role will close on November 16th.

Important Information

Concern has an organisational Code of Conduct supported by three Associated Policies: The Programme Participant Protection Policy, the Child Safeguarding Policy, and the Anti-Trafficking in Persons Policy accessible here. These have been designed to ensure the highest level of protection for everyone the organization engages through its work.

The policies set out the behaviours and responsibilities that Concern staff, and all its representatives (including consultants, contractors, sub-contractors, suppliers, partners, visitors, ambassadors and Board members) are expected to uphold. They also articulate Concern’s commitment to safeguarding and protecting adults and children from harm in all aspects of our work. We will therefore do everything possible to ensure that only those who are suitable to work or volunteer with adults and children are recruited by us for such roles. Consequently, working or volunteering with Concern may be subject to a range of vetting checks, including criminal background checking. 

In this context, all staff and representatives of Concern have a responsibility to uphold the highest standards in their work, in accordance with Concern’s core values and mission. Any candidate offered a job with Concern Worldwide will be expected to sign the Concern Staff Code of Conduct and Associated Policies as an appendix to their contract of employment. By signing the Concern Code of Conduct, candidates acknowledge that they have understood the content of both the Concern Code of Conduct and the Associated Policies and agree to conduct themselves in accordance with the provisions of these policies.

Your Personal Data:

During this job application, you will provide Concern with your personal data. Concern takes its responsibilities towards this personal data very seriously and is committed to complying with all relevant data protection legislation. 

For additional information please consult our web site or contact the Human Resource Division in our Head Office. 

You have certain rights under data protection legislation. For more information on how to exercise those rights please visit Privacy statement for applicants | Concern Worldwide.

  • Work with application teams to integrate graph databases, knowledge graphs solutions within existing infrastructure.
  • Provide support for query optimization and data modeling for application-specific requirements.
  • Ensure that proper data security measures are implemented for graph databases and knowledge graphs.

Requirements:

  • 7-10 years of experience working with data engineering with at least 2-3 years of experience working on graph databases.
  • Proficiency in query languages like Cypher or Gremlin and a solid foundation in graph theory are crucial for success in this position.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Superior analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience in working in dual shore engagement is preferred.

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6586/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> London
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://www.medify.co.uk">http://www.medify.co.uk</a>
</p>

<p>Remote | Full-Time | UK&nbsp;<br><br></p>
<p>About Us</p>
<p>At Medify, we’re on a mission to widen access to medicine and healthcare careers through world-class digital learning experiences. Since 2009, we’ve helped thousands of students prepare for high-stakes admissions tests, and we’re continuing to invest in our technology to build innovative, scalable products that support learners around the world.</p>
<p>As we continue to grow, we’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead, mentor and develop our engineering team while remaining hands-on in building the platform that powers Medify.<br><br></p>
<p>The Role</p>
<p>As an Engineering Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping both our engineering culture and technical direction. Working closely with the CTO, Product and Design teams, you’ll lead a team of talented full-stack engineers, helping them grow while ensuring we continue to deliver high-quality software that delights our users.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on leadership role, with at least 50% of your time dedicated to engineering. You’ll contribute across the full software development lifecycle - from architecture and design through to development, testing and deployment - while driving engineering excellence and fostering a collaborative, high-performing team.</p>
<p>Our current technology stack includes Ruby on Rails, React, PostgreSQL, with infrastructure transitioning from Heroku to AWS.<br><br></p>
<p>Key Responsibilities</p>
<ul>
<li>Lead, mentor and support a team of full-stack engineers through coaching, regular 1:1s and performance reviews.</li>
<li>Foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration and technical excellence.</li>
<li>Support career development, engagement and long-term capability building across the engineering team.</li>
<li>Contribute to hiring by supporting interviews and recruitment of exceptional engineering talent.</li>
<li>Design, develop and maintain scalable, high-quality software solutions.</li>
<li>Collaborate closely with Product and Design teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.</li>
<li>Participate in architectural decisions and help shape the future of the Medify platform.</li>
<li>Conduct thoughtful code reviews and promote engineering best practices.</li>
<li>Troubleshoot and resolve software issues while maintaining high standards of reliability and performance.</li>
<li>Develop automated tests and contribute to a robust testing culture.</li>
<li>Participate in agile planning, backlog refinement and sprint delivery.</li>
<li>Stay up to date with emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve our engineering practices.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>About You</p>
<p>You’ll be a technically strong engineering leader who enjoys developing people just as much as building great software. You’re comfortable balancing strategic leadership with hands-on development and thrive in a fast-moving, collaborative environment.</p>
<p>You’ll ideally have:</p>
<ul>
<li>2+ years’ experience leading or managing software engineering teams.</li>
<li>5+ years’ experience in software development.</li>
<li>Strong experience with modern software engineering practices and frameworks.</li>
<li>Experience with Ruby on Rails and React (highly desirable).</li>
<li>A proven track record of building scalable, maintainable software.</li>
<li>Experience working in Agile development environments.</li>
<li>Experience collaborating with cross-functional Product and Design teams.</li>
<li>Experience recruiting, mentoring and developing engineers.</li>
<li>Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.</li>
<li>Excellent problem-solving ability with a focus on quality and continuous improvement.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>Qualifications</p>
<ul>
<li>Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline is desirable, but not essential.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>Technical Skills</p>
<ul>
<li>Strong knowledge of modern programming languages and software frameworks.</li>
<li>Excellent understanding of software architecture, design principles, data structures and algorithms.</li>
<li>Experience working with relational databases, APIs and networking.</li>
<li>Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and software quality practices.</li>
<li>Familiarity with DevOps tools and deployment pipelines.</li>
<li>Ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies.</li>
<li>Excellent collaboration and communication skills.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>✅ What We Offer</p>
<ul>
<li>Fully remote working with flexibility and autonomy.</li>
<li>The opportunity to shape the future of Medify’s technology platform.</li>
<li>A supportive, collaborative engineering culture that values continuous learning.</li>
<li>A hands-on leadership role with real technical influence.</li>
<li>The opportunity to work on products that positively impact thousands of aspiring healthcare professionals every year.</li>
<li>Competitive salary and benefits package.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>How to Apply</p>
<p>If you’re passionate about building exceptional software, developing high-performing engineering teams and making a meaningful impact in education, we’d love to hear from you.</p>
<p>Submit your application along with your CV using the link attached.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/medify-engineering-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/medify-engineering-manager</a></p>
